mission: The discordance is at critical. Sera's jaw set, Kael's hands shaking, Ben's fist around three traditions that refuse to combine. One breath, one decision — Ben lets go. Stops leading. Listens. The three notes find their own relationship. The chord forms. Warmth floods through their linked hands. The wrongness he has heard for months goes quiet.
why_now: The climax breakthrough. Ben's arc completes in an action, not an articulation. Every previous chapter has trained the reader to wait for this exact letting-go.
conflict: Every trained instinct says lead, drive, impose. The resonance refuses. Ben holds the last piece of the thing he has carried since he was a boy — the Skywalker reflex — and puts it down.
turning_point: Ben stops leading and starts listening. The three traditions find their own relationship without his hand steering them. The chord forms.
opening_hook: The discordance is reaching critical. Sera's jaw is set. Kael's hands are shaking. Nothing Ben tries is working.
closing_hook: The resonance catches. The warmth returns — real and immediate, not metaphorical. The wrongness that has been with Ben for months goes quiet.
emotional_trajectory: Desperate control -> the moment of surrender -> the breakthrough warmth

stakes.personal: Ben's arc resolving through a physical act of letting go
stakes.interpersonal: Three traditions harmonising — the book's argument made physical
stakes.external: The resonance works. The question is whether it is enough.

setting: Veranthos — mid-valley, hands linked, the resonance catching
sensory_details: The three notes finding their own relationship — not any single tradition's structure but a chord none of them authored alone; warmth returning through the Force after cold, physical warmth in linked palms; the lattice reforming as living tissue rather than a rigid grid; relief like breathing after nearly drowning
action_beats: Sera sets her jaw and Kael's hands tremble as the discordance reaches critical — the resonance failing
Ben releases his grip on control — stops leading, starts listening — and the three traditions find their own relationship
The resonance catches and warmth floods through their linked hands — physical, not metaphorical, after months of cold

notes: The book's thematic pivot expressed as a physical action. Ben's letting-go is not an insight paragraph; it is breath, weight shift, open hands. Use the force_mechanics lattice-resonance vocabulary: discordant start, three notes finding their own relationship, warmth returning after cold, living tissue rather than rigid grid. Do not reuse 'handrail' or 'flat-note' here; Ben has moved past that vocabulary by the climax. Diagnostic-voice trap — Ben should not, in this scene, interior-paragraph the arc completion. The action carries the completion; interiority is a breath out, maybe a sentence fragment. Voice: Stover-permitted density for the letting-go itself, Zahn-restraint around it.
